axes.observation: Both atlas kidneys use pinned OBJ members in the original frame. Gland extrema on all three axes match their original bounds; smooth local relief is editorial.

Both profiles remain distinct in the posterior pair and opposite neutral view. The enlarged left profile retains its broad concavity while the distracting pits recede. Both glands retain manifold topology and have zero detected nonadjacent triangle contacts.
The kidney pair now stays in the exact download. The posterior frame and gland-only comparison identify upper-pole association on each side.
Four selectable meshes and 11,582 triangles deliver both gland profiles and the same-side kidney context. The gland indices retain the source tessellation.

assessments.task: Follow the HRA pancreas from the head in the duodenal bend toward the tail beside the splenic context.

axes.observation: A reconstructed envelope follows all five original region surfaces. Eleven adjacent source meshes preserve their unique geometric positions and triangle counts on clean import. Sampled source-to-envelope distances include the uncinate and head separately.

The enlarged head reads as a continuous broad surface through the turn into the body; the highlighted seam of the individual atlas patches no longer separates the gross contour. The reverse view preserves the directional change approaching the tail. The mesh has one connected shell and no detected nonadjacent triangle contacts.
The teaching file opens with the pancreatic exterior, the duodenal bend and splenic context. The learner can locate both endpoints in the paired directions and isolate the envelope.
The teaching selection has 28,588 triangles, including 11,088 on the envelope, and occupies about 596 kB. The original has 38,598 triangles and includes internal structures outside the locator task.

The two enlarged directions show the corner turning continuously into the upper end. Endpoint symbols identify both limits separately from the width of the stroke and the angle of a cut surface. Neither terminal is extended.
The central trace is emphasized against the muted context in the downloadable scene. The angle change separates its top turn from the side guide; the lower marker identifies the depicted lower stop.

Seven sampled lines and two small end markers use 644 triangles in about 31 kB. The additional faces encode rounded corners and selectable end symbols; no continuous anatomical lumen or flow is represented.
